data.sql:
WITH patient_loc AS (
  SELECT lat AS lat1, lon AS lon1 FROM workspace.virtue_clean.pincode_lookup WHERE pincode = '225001'
),
nearby_hospitals AS (
  SELECT 
    fse.unique_id,
    fse.name,
    fse.city,
    fse.service,
    fse.service_label,
    fse.confidence,
    fse.official_phone,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(try_divide(RADIANS(fse.lat - pl.lat1),2)), 2) + COS(RADIANS(pl.lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(fse.lat)) * POWER(SIN(try_divide(RADIANS(fse.lon - pl.lon1),2)), 2))) AS distance_km
  FROM workspace.virtue_clean.facility_service_evidence fse
  CROSS JOIN patient_loc pl
  WHERE fse.service = 'emergency_c_section'
    AND fse.facility_type = 'hospital'
    AND fse.confidence IN ('High','Medium')
    AND fse.lat IS NOT NULL
    AND fse.lon IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  unique_id,
  name,
  city,
  service,
  service_label,
  confidence,
  ROUND(distance_km, 1) AS distance_km,
  official_phone,
  CASE WHEN confidence = 'Low' THEN 'Evidence is weak' ELSE NULL END AS evidence_note
FROM nearby_hospitals
WHERE distance_km < 100
ORDER BY confidence DESC, distance_km ASC
LIMIT 5;
